```artifact
Feature: Alarms
  As a user
  I want the GUI to compute alarms for VTI and VTE
  So that I can be notified of potential issues

  Scenario: LOW VTI alarm computation
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 50
    And the current breath VTI is 60
    When the GUI computes the LOW VTI alarm
    Then the LOW VTI alarm is active
    And the LOW VTI alarm priority is medium

  Scenario: HIGH VTI alarm computation
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 100
    And the current breath VTI is 120
    When the GUI computes the HIGH VTI alarm
    Then the HIGH VTI alarm is active
    And the HIGH VTI alarm priority is medium

  Scenario: LOW VTE alarm computation
    Given the VTE threshold is set to 20
    And the current breath VTE is 30
    When the GUI computes the LOW VTE alarm
    Then the LOW VTE alarm is active
    And the LOW VTE alarm priority is medium

  Scenario: VTI computation for each breath
    Given the current breath is 1
    When the GUI computes the VTI for the current breath
    Then the VTI for the current breath is calculated correctly

  Scenario: Setting the VTI threshold
    Given the VTI threshold is set to 50
    When the user sets the VTI threshold to 75
    Then the VTI threshold is updated to 75

  Scenario Outline: VTI threshold setting
    Given the VTI threshold is set to <threshold>
    When the user sets the VTI threshold to <new_threshold>
    Then the VTI threshold is updated to <new_threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold | new_threshold |
      | 50        | 75            |
      | 75        | 50            |
      | 0         | 100           |
      | 100       | 0             |

  Scenario: HIGH VTI alarm priority
    Given the HIGH VTI alarm is active
    When the GUI computes the HIGH VTI alarm priority
    Then the HIGH VTI alarm priority is medium

  Scenario: LOW VTI alarm priority
    Given the LOW VTI alarm is active
    When the GUI computes the LOW VTI alarm priority
    Then the LOW VTI alarm priority is medium

  Scenario: LOW VTE alarm priority
    Given the LOW VTE alarm is active
    When the GUI computes the LOW VTE alarm priority
    Then the LOW VTE alarm priority is medium
```
